state.previous_paragraph: Later on May 22, 2013, representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch presented to the members of the Transaction Committee for purposes of a potential engagement in connection with the Board's current review of strategic alternatives and the possibility of undertaking a sale process.
state.paragraph: On May 29, 2013, each of the other two financial advisor candidates presented to the members of the Transaction Committee for purposes of a potential engagement in connection with the Board's current review of strategic alternatives and the possibility of undertaking a sale process.
